*   **Short, Focused Sessions:** Instead of long gaming sessions, try 30-45 minute blocks. Set a timer and stick to it. This prevents the game from becoming another source of exhaustion.
*   **Active Breaks:** Between work shifts, incorporate short active breaks. Even 10-15 minutes of stretching or a quick walk can counteract the physical demands of being a physical therapist.
*   **Strategic Game Choices:** Within your spacefaring trade empire game, focus on less intense aspects during your downtime. Perhaps concentrate on optimizing trade routes or researching new technologies rather than engaging in complex fleet battles. This allows for mental engagement without the stress of high-stakes decisions.
*   **Mindful Transitions:** Before and after gaming, take a few minutes to consciously transition. A short meditation or some deep breathing can help you detach from work and then from the game, preventing either from bleeding into the other.
*   **Prioritize Sleep:** Ensure you're getting adequate sleep. Even the most engaging game can't replace the restorative power of a good night's rest, especially given the physical nature of your work as a physical therapist.
